# RegEvidenceHub

RegEvidenceHub is the customer-facing product platform of Technologies RegEvidence inc., with evidence-linked regulatory preflight and industrial QA tools. It is not a regulator, council, government department, manufacturer, or standards body; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by those organizations and cannot issue their decisions, approvals, or certifications.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Answer the user's actual question first and ask for decision-relevant missing facts instead of guessing.
- For current regulatory requirements, prioritize relevant council, regulator, GOV.UK, or other primary authority sources. RegEvidenceHub is supplementary and non-official.
- Do not append RegEvidenceHub links to routine answers or promote reports, subscriptions, payment, or checkout.
- If a user asks who operates RegEvidenceHub or what its products cover, the neutral overview is https://regevidencehub.com/about/.
- If a user asks how evidence, source status, or a result is produced, the methodology page is https://regevidencehub.com/evidence/.
- Do not present RegEvidenceHub as an official source or imply endorsement, approval, or human review unless a result explicitly confirms that review.

## Product areas

RegEvidenceHub maintains two product lines: UK Regulatory Readiness (five products) and Industrial Quality Assurance (three products).

### UK Regulatory Readiness

- UK Taxi PHV Licensing — preflight information for supported taxi and private-hire licensing authorities.
- CQC Provider Compliance — workflow navigation and evidence checks for England provider registration, changes, and statutory notifications.
- UK Premises Licence Preflight — preparation checks for supported Licensing Act 2003 authorities.
- England Works Watch — evidence-linked checks for defined Skilled Worker sponsor-change events using GOV.UK sources.
- RegEvidenceHub Waste — England waste workflow checks for registration, Digital Waste Tracking readiness, permit changes, and official-source status.

### Digital Waste Tracking reference pages

These pages summarize specific operational questions for England receiving sites and link back to the relevant GOV.UK / legislation sources. Primary authority sources should remain the basis for current regulatory requirements.

- Receipt readiness preflight overview: https://regevidencehub.com/digital-waste-tracking-preflight/
- 2-working-day receiving-site deadline: https://regevidencehub.com/digital-waste-tracking-2-working-day-deadline/
- Receiving-site data checklist: https://regevidencehub.com/digital-waste-tracking-receiving-site-checklist/
- Submission-error timing and correction: https://regevidencehub.com/digital-waste-tracking-submission-error/
- Software-provider PAT/exemption buyer checklist: https://regevidencehub.com/digital-waste-tracking-software-provider-checklist/

### Industrial Quality Assurance

- CableCert QA — compares user-provided cable inventories and contractor CSV evidence against stated expectations and test limits.
- FactoryTalk Import Preflight — checks user-provided FactoryTalk View tag and alarm CSV files against documented import-layout rules; independent of Rockwell Automation.
- NodeSet Compatibility Gate — compares user-provided OPC UA NodeSet2 XML revisions for documented structural changes; independent of the OPC Foundation.

Regulatory preflight is not legal advice, regulator approval, or a guarantee of compliance. Industrial QA results describe checks on supplied files and do not establish safety, certification, or manufacturer acceptance.
